title: Moved into a managerial role leading software excellence transformation projects
summary: From March 2021, as Software Competency Specialist II in a managerial capacity, I led software excellence transformation projects for Philips businesses from scoping to final report. I directed small rotating teams of architects and specialists and reported results to business leaders.
what_would_have_happened: Not applicable: a role event, not an intervention.
the_call: Own each transformation project from scoping to the final report.
what_i_did: Scoped each project with the business heads, allocated and supervised the work of a small rotating team of architects and specialists, tracked it against a plan and presented findings and remediation actions to them.
what_changed: I was promoted to Software Excellence Competency Lead with the November 2021 transfer to Philips North America, and my manager wrote that the promotion was deserved.

quotes.text: Datta has been a pivotal member of the SW CoE team for years and has been deservedly rewarded with a promotion this year.
